I saved this to the project's shared memory: Priya owns the ledger integration, and any change to `src/billing/invoices.py` needs her review. It's tied to that file, so it will come up whenever someone edits it.

It sits next to an existing warning about the same file: `finalize()` isn't safe to call twice, because a second call posts to the ledger again. Changes to it should use `finalize_once()`, which checks whether the invoice was already posted.
